name: Risk management: risk and exception release gate
what_it_needs: The risk decision, and any hold or restart.
risk_addressed: Unaccepted material risk or a failed verification is treated as safe for reliance.
control: Before deployment and after material change, assess the risk register and approve acceptance criteria. For each matter, hard-gate failures or material exceptions hold dependent analysis and block release until reviewed.
owner: AI Governance Lead (provider); AI System Owner decides suspension and restart.
evidence: Risk assessment; acceptance criteria; gate and hold record; exception decision; restart approval.
minimum_evidence_fields: Risk limit; exception or hold; action; decision; restart authorisation

name: Human oversight: named report-review gate
what_it_needs: A named reviewer, the exact report hash and the decision.
risk_addressed: Automation bias, or unauthorised reliance on a convincing but flawed report.
control: Before any report is relied on, a competent named tribunal reviewer checks the exact report version, material authorities, holds and limitations, and approves, rejects or returns it with reasons. Changed content invalidates approval.
owner: Judicial / ADR Deployer Lead; the named human reviewer performs the review.
evidence: Reviewer assignment and competence record; report hash; reviewed limitations; signed approval or rejection; override reasons.
minimum_evidence_fields: Reviewer ID; report hash; known limits; approve or reject reason

name: Transparency: source-linked status and limitation display
what_it_needs: The claim, its source and its limitations, shown.
risk_addressed: Misleading certainty conceals weak evidence, outdated law or unverified conclusions.
control: At draft and release, label each material proposition verified, held, excluded or unresolved; show the source locator, the relevant legal-status date, any failed check and the limitation. Never let a fluent narrative replace those labels.
owner: Legal Source & Evidence Steward (provider); the reviewer checks intelligibility.
evidence: Versioned report; claim-to-source map; verification and status labels; limitations and reviewer acknowledgement.
minimum_evidence_fields: Claim ID; source and locator; status and date; visible limitations

name: Monitoring: control-evidence monitoring and escalation
what_it_needs: Alerts, and what was done about them.
risk_addressed: Quality degradation, recurrent overrides or missed gate failures continue unnoticed.
control: At each run, collect failed checks, holds, release approvals and audit-integrity results. Review trends weekly during a pilot; alert at once on a hard-gate bypass or an unauthorised release. Revalidate after model, source or policy changes.
owner: Model / Validation Owner (provider); the Engineering Lead triages; the Governance Lead escalates.
evidence: Monitoring snapshot; alert or incident record; trend review; change-impact and regression-test record.
minimum_evidence_fields: Threshold; alert; affected run; owner; follow-up; re-test

name: Data governance: approved legal-source and status gate
what_it_needs: The approved source, and three separate checks.
risk_addressed: An invented, stale, manipulated or unsupported authority contaminates downstream analysis.
control: At intake and retrieval, restrict sources to approved, matter-appropriate repositories; record source, jurisdiction, version, locator and retrieval date. Separately test citation existence, current-law status on the relevant date and proposition support; an unknown or failed material check triggers a hold. Access to the matter's data, its integrity and its confidentiality sit here too.
owner: Legal Source & Evidence Steward (provider); the Engineering Lead enforces the gate.
evidence: Approved-source register; source manifest; three check results; status timestamp; failed-check and hold log.
minimum_evidence_fields: Approved source and version; three checks; hold and dependency trace
